WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_transaction_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(avg_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transaction_amount,
        AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    avg_account_transaction_amount,
    avg_account_balance,
    avg_account_transaction_amount /
        NULLIF(AVG(avg_account_transaction_amount) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_overall_region_mean
FROM region_averages;

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the plain average of the regional averages of per-account transaction amount averages; SQL returns NULL for the ratio when that mean is missing or zero.
